name: United States (20 stars, 1818–1819)
description: Thirteen alternating red and white stripes with a navy canton bearing twenty white five-pointed stars in four rows of five.
history: The first flag under the Flag Act of 4 April 1818, which returned the stripes to thirteen and provided for one star per state added on the Fourth of July after admission. Effective 4 July 1818, it carried twenty stars for the states then in the Union, including Tennessee, Ohio, Louisiana, Indiana and Mississippi; the 21-star flag for Illinois followed on 4 July 1819.
